headlines.title: Binance targeted in $6.3 billion crypto heist, the largest ever
headlines.description: The company has suspended all deposits and withdrawals while it works with law enforcement to secure its infrastructure and locate stolen funds.

headlines.title: Alphabet shares record their worst day ever, shedding $500 billion in value
headlines.description: Shares of Google parent company Alphabet sank 12.6%, the company’s worst ever single-day drop.

headlines.title: Polymarket briefly halts trading after third-party compromise and reports of stolen user funds
headlines.description: Predictions markets platform Polymarket was forced to halt trading on its international platform for an hour after a vendor was compromised.

headlines.title: Data center group jumps into the Kansas governor’s race to boost Republicans
headlines.description: Building the Future is an offshoot of the pro-AI super PAC Leading the Future, arguably the leading super PAC promoting industry interests in the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Google stock's historically bad day raises fears of AI bubble popping
headlines.description: Google's parent company Alphabet lost over $500 billion in market value today. So is the AI bubble about to pop? NBC News' Allie Canal reports on big tech's spending and how AI is impacting the job market.

headlines.title: Spooky book recommendations for Halloween weekend
headlines.description: Abbie Konnick, creator and moderator of the Twisted Book Club, talks with NBC News’ Gadi Schwartz to share her top picks for spooky reads perfect for Halloween weekend.

headlines.title: Portable phone charger explodes on camera inside California home
headlines.description: Surveillance video captures a portable phone charger bursting into flames inside a California home, as a deadly New York City battery fire and a new recall raise safety concerns. NBC News' Andres Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: New report says Nvidia CEO was possible target of Chinese spy plot
headlines.description: A new report from the New York Times reveals that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a possible Chinese spy plot, involving an executive at a Singapore-based company. NBC News has not independently confirmed the details of the investigation.

headlines.title: Advocate for Elizabeth Holmes' innocence threatens to sue A24, Nathan Fielder over doc
headlines.description: New bombshell A24 documentary “You Can See Everything” draws backlash from a supporter of Elizabeth Holmes’ technology after clips of him were in the film, he says, without his permission. Now, he’s threatening to sue the filmmakers if they don't apologize. NBC News’ Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Screens crack on Apple’s new foldable iPhone
headlines.description: The iPhone Duo went on sale less than a week ago, but some users are already reporting cracks and bright lines across the inner display near the hinge. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to More Than 25% of Workforce
headlines.description: Microsoft announced Monday it is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, more than a quarter of its global workforce. It is unclear how many positions the tech giant hopes to eliminate.

headlines.title: AI startup Anthropic unveils its public IPO filing for the first time
headlines.description: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic unveiled its public IPO filing for the first time ahead of what is expected to be one of the largest stock debuts in history. NBC News' Allie Canal reports on the details surrounding Anthropic ahead of its IPO.
